thread.title: Baylor softball players Carter and Marshall receive Big 12 postseason honors
thread.title_full: Baylor softball players Carter and Marshall receive Big 12 postseason honors

author: k. b. ramos
title: Baylor softball players Carter and Marshall receive Big 12 postseason honors
text:
Baylor softball players Brooklyn Carter and Kaygen Marshall received Big 12 postseason honors, according to a May 6 announcement from the league office. Carter was named to the All-Big 12 Defensive Team, while Marshall earned a spot on the Big 12 All-Freshman Team.
These recognitions highlight individual achievements within the Baylor program as well as their contributions during the season. Such awards can help bring attention to standout performances in collegiate athletics.
Carter, who was previously selected as a preseason All-Big 12 pick, recorded a .978 fielding percentage with four outfield assists in center field. She had 87 putouts and only two errors in 93 chances. Her defensive skills included range and closing speed that erased hits in the gap, along with arm strength that limited opposing baserunners. Offensively, she led the Big 12 in stolen bases during conference play with ten steals. Carter is Baylor’s third player named to the All-Defensive Team over the last two seasons.
Marshall started all 52 games she played this season for Baylor. After beginning her debut year alternating between first and third base, she settled at third—a position she had not played before joining Baylor. She led her team with ten home runs, matching a mark set by Kassidy Krupit in 2019 for most homers by a freshman under coach Glenn Moore’s tenure. Defensively, Marshall contributed at third base with involvement in more than one hundred fifty plays throughout the season.
Both athletes are expected to return when Baylor faces Texas Tech on Thursday afternoon at Devon Park in Oklahoma City for the quarterfinals of the Big 12 Softball Championship. The tournament will be broadcast live on ESPN+ Thursday and Friday; Saturday’s championship game will air on ESPN.
